SORT crewmates Pam and Rob must now figure out how to move the patient across difficult ground and into a waiting ambulance. Fortunately, they have their Wolverine all-terrain vehicle to hand. Based in a community of around 10,000 people, Buckie teammates Vicki and Elaine often encounter friends and acquaintances on their ambulance shifts. The crew work closely with fire and rescue to lower a paramedic down by rope to administer vital pain relief to the patient. Thoughts then turn to how the emergency services can get the patient to safety. In Edinburgh, teammates Kevin and Martyn respond to a 999 call from a concerned member of the public after a man is found unconscious in the city centre. They arrive to find that the patient is a familiar face - a homeless man with an alcohol dependency, and who is a frequent user of the ambulance service. Not long after taking this unfortunate patient to hospital, the team receive another 999 call - the same man has been found passed out in the street, having absconded from A&E. The crew now face the dilemma of how to best treat this struggling person.
programme.title: Paramedics On Scene

programme.desc: S21 E1 — Warriors of the Deep: Part 1 Seabase 4 is on alert. A strange craft is approaching but the crew has been infiltrated by the enemy, so Commander Vorshak's solutions are stopped at every turn.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S21 E2 — Warriors of the Deep: Part 2 The Silurians and Sea Devils send the Myrka in as a spearhead to the invasion of the Seabase, whilst Nilson and Doctor Solow work to bring the entire Bloc down.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S21 E3 — Warriors of the Deep: Part 3 As Vorshak’s crew are cut down one by one by Sauvix's Sea Devil Warriors, the Doctor is running out of ways to broker a peace between mammal and reptile.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S21 E4 — Warriors of the Deep: Part 4 Lethal hexachromite gas is used against the invaders and the Doctor is despondent that no one wants to find another way to avoid so much death.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S21 E5 — The Awakening: Part 1 Teacher Jane Hampden is increasingly frustrated by the war games being played around the village, but the Doctor is more alarmed to find a boy transported from the 17th century.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S21 E6 — The Awakening: Part 2 The Malus’s influence is asserting itself all over Little Hodcombe, and the war games take an unpleasant turn. The Doctor’s best defence is in the TARDIS - but the Malus is inside.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S21 E7 — Frontios: Part 1 Captain Revere is the latest person to be sucked beneath the ground on Frontios, leaving the young Plantagenet to run the colony. The Doctor’s TARDIS has also been destroyed.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S21 E8 — Frontios: Part 2 Trying to discover why Frontios is being attacked from both above and below, the Doctor faces the malevolent Tractators while revolution brews in the colony.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S21 E9 — Frontios: Part 3 Turlough’s race memories of the Frontios threaten to overwhelm him as the Doctor finally convinces Brazen that the threat from underground is very real.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S21 E10 — Frontios: Part: 4 The Doctor manipulates the Gravis into restoring the TARDIS, but still has to find a way to break the Tractators’ hold over Frontios before they wipe out all life on the surface.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S21 E14 — Planet of Fire: Part 2 Kamelion has taken the TARDIS to Sarn and is trying to locate his master, while the Doctor explores the mystery of the Misos Triangle - much to Turlough's consternation.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S21 E15 — Planet of Fire: Part 3 Logar is angry and the volcano shakes with his displeasure – according to Timanov, who demands sacrifices to appease his god. Peri discovers the Master's whereabouts.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S21 E18 — The Caves of Androzani: Part 2 Military captive Salateen tells Peri and the Doctor they are dying from spectrox tomaemia and the only cure is the milk of the queen bat, who sleeps deep below the caverns.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S21 E19 — The Caves of Androzani: Part 3 As Morgus continues to plot his political future on Androzani Major, Sharez Jek insanely believes Peri will fall in love with him. The Doctor is caught by the gunrunners.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S21 E20 — The Caves of Androzani: Part 4 Morgus is ruined, exposed as the one funding Jek’s gunrunners, and Jek himself goes on a murderous rampage. Although dying from spectrox tomaemia the Doctor saves Peri.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
